title: SUINONG42: published cold-tolerant contrast, uncalibrated engineering reference

trait_reference.scope: Seedling chilling contrast supported by a 72-hour 4C chamber experiment. Native TMNFTB acts at all crop stages; that extension is an unvalidated engineering assumption. No frost survival, cold germination or mature-crop tolerance claim.

native_response.input: mean of up to seven daily minimum air temperatures, degC
native_response.assumption: The affine mapping, endpoint temperatures and extension beyond the seedling experiment are engineering assumptions. D is not a measured photosynthesis multiplier. No fitting to FAIRY yields.

sources.title: Wang et al. (2023), Comparison and Evaluation of Low-Temperature Tolerance of Different Soybean Cultivars during the Early-Growth Stage
Pinned upstream WOFOST 8.1 Soybean_901 native parameters
sources.license: EUPL as declared upstream; version unspecified

limitations: This is a complete executable native parameter set, not a published or locally validated WOFOST cultivar fit.
All non-trait parameters are copied from the pinned Northern-France Soybean_901 baseline, including thermal time, nitrogen, carbon allocation and rooting.
No conversion of active accumulated temperatures into TSUM, forced maturity, yield multiplication or harvest-gate bypass.
Quantitative trait mapping is an explicit engineering assumption; literature establishes experimental identity and ordering, not native parameter identification.
Legacy reduced-engine compatibility uses the unchanged STANDARD baseline and does not reproduce these native contrasts.
